title: StormCaller

body:
![Description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/814e3d66026b03565f5049898a664c7fd492f694.jpeg)

# 🏹 What is StormCaller?​
StormCaller is a powerful and fully customizable plugin that brings a unique trident mechanic to your server. With limited throws, automatic removal, and complete configuration, it’s perfect for RPG, PvP, and survival servers.

# 🌟 Why Choose StormCaller?​
- ✔️ Unique Combat Mechanics – Limited-use tridents create dynamic battles
- ✔️ Perfect for PvP & RPG Servers – Balanced gameplay for all server types
- ✔️ Boosts In-Game Economy – Sell it as a rare weapon in shops
- ✔️ Prevents Exploits – No more infinite-use tridents
- ✔️ Easy Setup & Customization – Plug & play with full configuration​

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55d81d2dc8d047c7b09738d7af72b2f5f2a3574c.png)

- 🎯 Limited Throws System – Each trident has a fixed number of uses before vanishing
- ⚔️ Customizable Damage & Settings – Adjust damage values and throw limits in config.yml
- ⚡ Loyalty & Auto-Removal – Tridents return to players (if enabled) but disappear when out of uses
- 🔥 StormCaller PRO (Paid Version) – Rechargeable tridents, special effects (lightning, particles, sounds), and in-game commands for full control

![DEMO](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4dfc24ed4ac7690c51f46c2570040f6507a2402.png)

# 📜 How to Use It?​
- 📌 Game Mode Integrations
- 💰 VIP & Donor Rewards – Offer it as an exclusive perk
- 🏹 Arena Battles & Events – Add to PvP combat arenas
- 📜 RPG Quests & Loot Drops – Use as a dungeon reward or rare boss drop

![Install](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfbdc50c5c029db4a09efa8b539fe6551873cb8f.png)

1.  Download & Install – Place StormCaller.jar in /plugins/ and restart your server
2.  Customize Settings – Edit damage, throw limits, and effects in config.yml
3.  Distribute Tridents – Use /givestormcaller to give tridents to players
4.  Integrate with Shops – Sell it via EssentialsX, Vault, or MythicMobs
